items.html: And indeed, what remains in doubt for us is what is written from here onward, for there are two explanations. One: that we say that the six aspects of the vessels — which are the three inner vessels and the three outer vessels — may possibly be one within the other. Meaning: on the outside there is one outer vessel, and one inner vessel within it, and both are the aspect of Ibur; and within this there is a second vessel that has externality and internality, and they are the aspect of Yenika; and within this there is a third vessel that has externality and internality. And behold, within the internality of the outer vessel there is the Nefesh of the light of the Essence; and within the aspect of the internality of the second vessel there is the Ruach of the Essence; and within the aspect of the internality of the third vessel, the innermost of all, there is the Neshama of the Essence.
